Commentary.Commentary: Asghar Stanikzai bags the Man of the Match award for his excellent knock. That's all from this game. Do join us on 19th February for the second ODI at 0930 local (0730 GMT). Until then, it's goodbye from all of us here. Cheers!
The match was taking an interesting turn but then the heavens opened up and spoiled all the fun. The timing of the rain gods favoured Afghanistan today but it could have gone either way.

Earlier in the match, a good bowling performance by Zimbabwe restricted Afghanistan to a low total. The chase didn't initiate well for the home team though. The Afghan bowlers didn't let them off the hook by bowling tidy lines and chipped early wickets. Craig Ervine, however, held one end tightly and his 55-run partnership with Burl kept the game in balance.

Zimbabwe will be heartbroken with the outcome of this match. As mentioned before, they were ahead on the DL count at the end of the 27th over but the wicket of debutant Ryan Burl proved costly as it pushed Afghanistan ahead.

It's all over. The rain stopped quite a while back but the damage it did to the outfield was severe. The umpires and the match referee had a look and decided to call it off. AFGHANISTAN WIN BY 12 RUNS (DL METHOD)!

Update 1427 GMT (1627 local) - The rain has stopped and the covers are off. The target has been revised to 207 in 46 overs. So, the required equation for Zimbabwe - 108 needed off 112 balls. We might get underway soon, if there are no concerns with the outfield.

RAIN INTERRUPTION after 27.2 overs, Zimbabwe are 99/4! Oh dear, suddenly the heavens have opened up and the players have rushed back to the dressing room. It's unfortunate for Zimbabwe as prior to the start of the 28th over, they were ahead by one run on the DL count. But since they lost Ryan Burl on the first ball, Afghanistan have gone ahead. The home side will hope that the rain stops soon and the game resumes.
OUT lbw b Rashid Khan. Zimbabwe have lost their fourth wicket.

After 25 overs, Zimbabwe are 86/3, needing 130 more off 150 balls. Another slow passage of play for them and the debutant Ryan Burl also got a reprieve as he was dropped on 18 by Mohammad Nabi. The required run-rate is rising but is not alarming yet. If the current partnership prospers, the away side will be in a state of worry.

After 20 overs, Zimbabwe are 67/3. The going has been slow for them in the last 5 overs but they are in no hurry as the required run-rate is well in check. The visitors will need to pick up quick wickets to get the upper hand in this game.

After 15 overs, Zimbabwe are struggling on 47/3. The visitors have managed to get the big fish in Sikandar Raza. They will wish to create further inroads. On the other hand, the debutant Ryan Burl is out in the middle and he will hope and try to give support to Craig Ervine. The hosts will wish for a good partnership between the two in order to stay on track in this run chase as they need another 169 runs off 35 overs for a win.
OUT c Mohammad Nabi b Gulbadin Naib. Zimbabwe have lost their third wicket.

After 10 overs, Zimbabwe have scored 37 runs for the loss of 2 wickets. It was a passage that Afghanistan dominated. Mohammad Nabi got rid of Moor off his very third ball in the 6th over. Sikandar Raza and Craig Ervine are batting at the centre. They will have to lay a solid foundation and ensure that the asking rate doesn't increase.
OUT c Dawlat Zadran b Mohammad Nabi. Zimbabwe have lost their second wicket.

After 5 overs, Zimbabwe are 21/1. A shaky start for the hosts, only Peter Moor has looked in some control so far. Amir Hamza trapped Mire lbw as the latter played a false shot only to walk away for 2 runs. The onus now is on Moor to hold the innings.
OUT lbw b Amir Hamza. Zimbabwe have lost their first wicket.

Welcome back for the run chase. The players are also back on the field. Peter Moor and Solomon Mire are the Zimbabwean openers. It's going to be Amir Hamza to begin proceedings with the ball for Afghanistan. Unfortunately, due to lack of television feed, there won't be ball-by-ball commentary for this match but we shall keep you posted with updates.
